## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm exec prettier --check .` and `pnpm test` pass
- [ ] Tests added or updated for the change
- [ ] No SQL built from user input (quoted identifiers, parameters)
- [ ] Design tokens only, 4.5:1 text contrast, state not shown by color alone
- [ ] User-facing change noted in `CHANGELOG.md` (in French)
